qwen.name: Qwen Team (Alibaba)
qwen.role: Original weights. Publishes BF16 references plus official FP8 exports.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia.role: ModelOpt NVFP4 quantizations, tuned for Blackwell and DGX Spark.

redhatai.name: Red Hat AI
redhatai.role: Enterprise-grade NVFP4 / INT4 quantizations with published eval deltas.

radixark.name: RadixArk
radixark.role: NVFP4 exports and the DSpark draft models. Their BF16-lm_head export is what the SGLang cookbook measured against.

unsloth.name: Unsloth
unsloth.role: Dynamic GGUF and NVFP4 quants across every Qwen. Publishes tool-call fixes and per-quant accuracy tables.

incoai.name: inco.ai
incoai.role: DFlash2 authors; mirror of the z-lab drafts plus the SGLang serving recipe.

mia-ai-lab.name: Mia's AI Lab
mia-ai-lab.role: DGX Spark serving recipes: the 27B SGLang stack and the single-Spark Flash-Next build.

albond.name: Albond
albond.role: INT4-hybrid single-Spark recipes for 100B-class MoE models.

azampatti.name: azampatti
azampatti.role: Single-Spark SGLang Flash-Next recipe; easiest install of the five known builds.

blazux.name: blazux
blazux.role: vLLM hybrid mmap Flash-Next build; hybrid FP8 sides give roughly +20%.

saren.name: Saren
saren.role: Fork of the blazux build with higher reported code and JSON scores.

orcarouter.name: OrcaRouter
orcarouter.role: Uncensored Flash-Next GGUF plus a custom Rust engine fork. Gated download; not SGLang/vLLM compatible.

hasso5703.name: hasso5703
hasso5703.role: Published DSpark-on-GB10 config that this repo's DSpark flag stack builds on.

mlx-community.name: MLX Community
mlx-community.note: Apple MLX exports of open weights for local Mac inference.

bartowski.name: bartowski
bartowski.note: Prolific GGUF quant publisher; per-quant cards with llama.cpp test notes.

quanttrio.name: QuantTrio
quanttrio.note: AWQ/GPTQ-style quants aimed at vLLM serving.

szibis.name: szibis (mlx-flash)
szibis.note: Author of mlx-flash: SSD-streamed MoE experts on Apple Silicon.

waybarrios.name: waybarrios (vllm-mlx)
waybarrios.note: Author of vllm-mlx: continuous-batching OpenAI-compatible server on native MLX.

outsourc-e.name: outsourc-e
outsourc-e.note: Single-24GB-GPU llama.cpp recipes with same-vocab speculative decoding.

r0b0tlab.name: r0b0tlab
r0b0tlab.note: Click-run SGLang speculative-decoding scripts for SM121 (DGX Spark).

oscaractual.name: OscarActual
oscaractual.note: GB10 (ThinkStation PGX) Ollama benchmark across 11 local models.

ollama.name: Ollama library
ollama.note: Packaged default-quant pulls of open weights.

drluoto.name: drluoto
drluoto.note: Strix Halo (Ryzen AI Max+ 395) Qwen3.8-Flash-Next stack with native MTP on ROCm, plus the shard-scalpel MTP-head extractor.

entrpi.name: Entrpi
entrpi.note: DFlash block-diffusion spec-dec installer for the 122B on Spark.

sojufx.name: sojufx
sojufx.note: Native-vLLM production serve recipe for 122B NVFP4 + DFlash on Spark.

hudsonwa.name: hudsonwa
hudsonwa.note: oMLX 8-slot concurrent Flash-Next serving recipe on 128 GB Macs.

pipenetwork.name: PipeNetwork
pipenetwork.note: MLX runtime + streaming quantization for the Flash-Next architecture.

petems.name: petems
petems.note: Decision-tree runbook for Qwen on 32-64 GB Apple Silicon MacBooks.

atomicchat.name: Atomic Chat
atomicchat.role: Atomic Chat app vendor (Jan fork; atomic-llama-cpp-turboquant engine). 'Atomic Dynamic' GGUF/MLX quants with own imatrix, held-out perplexity vs BF16 published per quant.
atomicchat.note: Not yet on the law-11 Scenario B whitelist — lanes recorded from forum/vendor measurements pending owner whitelist decision. Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF: 305k+ downloads.

shennguyen.name: shennguyen (Huihui)
shennguyen.note: Abliterated (refusal-removed) GGUF distills; Huihui-Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Claude-4.7-Opus-abliterated. Not on the law-11 whitelist — advice lane only.

ggml-org.name: ggml-org
ggml-org.role: Official llama.cpp project org: the engine itself plus reference GGUF quants (incl. mtp-* draft files) and the full-cuda container.

analogalok.name: analogalok
analogalok.note: Community builder: RTX 4090 benchmark runs for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (hybrid/full CPU-MoE offload, 250k ctx) and Qwen3.8-27B AD-Q4_K (KV/MTP context ladders) with exact repro commands.

minachist.name: Minachist
minachist.role: INT6 mixed-precision AutoRound quant of Qwen3.8-27B (community).

jonathancoletti.name: JonathanColetti
jonathancoletti.role: Community uncensored GGUF quants of Qwen3.8-27B.

google.name: Google DeepMind
google.role: Original Gemma 4 weights (E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, 31B) plus official QAT Q4_0 GGUF exports.

prismml.name: PrismML
prismml.role: Bonsai: end-to-end ternary (1.58-bit) and 1-bit retrains of Qwen models, with their own llama.cpp and MLX kernels.

underdog.name: Underdog AI (ConwayResearch)
underdog.role: Saluki: a 2-bit Qwen3.8-27B GGUF tuned to keep tool calling, for stock llama.cpp.

ista-daslab.name: IST Austria DASLab
ista-daslab.role: GSQ-RCO mixed-precision GGUFs (2-3.5 bits) with per-file accuracy tables against BF16 and Unsloth UD.

openbmb.name: OpenBMB
openbmb.role: MiniCPM-V vision models; MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B uses Qwen3.6 as its language backbone.

convai.name: Convai Innovations
convai.role: Laya: open, encoder-based (ModernBERT) decision models with a Jev-compatible server.

bespokelabs.name: Bespoke Labs
bespokelabs.role: Nimble: a 9B decision model fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-9B.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.role: Clef and Clef-Flash: open decision models fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.5-9B.

liquidai.name: Liquid AI
liquidai.role: d1: open decision models on the LFM2.5 backbone.

togetherai.name: Together AI
togetherai.role: Tev1: experimental decision models fine-tuned from Qwen3.5 (4B and 0.8B).

autotrust.name: AutoTrust
autotrust.role: JEV-27B-VL and siblings: decision models on Qwen backbones, served with vLLM.
